online-timer.name: Online Timer
online-timer.tagline: Count down to zero — or count up from it.
online-timer.metaTitle: Online Timer - Free Countdown Timer & Stopwatch | JaurTools
online-timer.metaDescription: Free online timer: a beeping countdown timer and a precision stopwatch with laps, right in your browser. No signup needed.
online-timer.keywords: countdown timer, online timer, stopwatch, timer with alarm, pomodoro timer
online-timer.quickAnswer: A countdown timer and a stopwatch in one: set any hours, minutes, and seconds for a beeping countdown, or count up with lap splits. Both are deadline-accurate, work in background tabs, and never send data anywhere.
keyFacts: The countdown measures against an absolute deadline, so switching tabs or minimizing the browser cannot make it lose time.
Pause truly freezes time — the deadline shifts forward by exactly the paused duration on resume.
The stopwatch resolves hundredths of a second, enough for sports training and lab-style timing.
The finish beep is synthesized live with the Web Audio API — no audio file is downloaded.
All state lives in the page's memory; a refresh starts everything over.
howTo: Pick the Countdown tab, set hours, minutes, and seconds, then press Start.
Pause freezes the remaining time; Resume continues from the exact frozen value; Reset restores your set duration.
When it hits zero you get three beeps and a clear 'time's up' state.
Switch to the Stopwatch tab for count-up timing — Start, Pause, Reset, and Lap for split times.
Clear laps when you are done; closing the tab wipes everything.
online-timer.formula:
Countdown:
totalMs = (h x 3600 + m x 60 + s) x 1000
deadline = startTime + totalMs
remaining = deadline - now   (recomputed every 100 ms)

Stopwatch:
elapsed = accumulated + (now - lastStart)
Laps record the elapsed value at each tap.
online-timer.workedExample:
Set 1 h 30 m 0 s:
total = 1 x 3600 + 30 x 60 + 0 = 5,400 seconds = 5,400,000 ms
deadline = now + 5,400,000 ms
The display counts 1:30:00 → 00:00, then beeps three times.
Pause at 1:12:33 freezes remaining = 4,353,000 ms; resume sets a new deadline = now + 4,353,000 ms — not a millisecond lost.
benefits: Pomodoro sessions, cooking, workouts, and exams get a reliable countdown with zero setup.
The stopwatch's lap memory beats scribbling split times on paper.
Deadline-based math means background tabs cannot make the timer drift.
No account, no install — it is ready before a native app would finish launching.
limitations: The finish beep needs the tab to be audible — a muted tab or silent device stays silent.
Very long countdowns (many hours) depend on the device staying awake; aggressive battery savers may pause the page.
Hundredths on the stopwatch are display resolution; the tab's refresh rate limits what you see, not what is measured.
Estimates only — not certified for competitions or legal timing.
online-timer.privacyNote: This tool runs 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.a: Yes. The countdown is computed from an absolute deadline (Date.now()), not by counting ticks, so background throttling cannot make it drift. The display simply refreshes when you return.
faqs.q: Will the timer keep running if I switch tabs?

faqs.a: Yes — three short beeps through your device's audio, plus a clear on-screen 'time's up' state. Keep the tab unmuted and your volume up.
faqs.q: Does it make a sound when finished?

faqs.a: Yes: set 25 minutes for focus, then 5 minutes for the break. Pause and resume handle interruptions honestly — paused time never counts down.
faqs.q: Can I use it as a Pomodoro timer?
